## Checklist · قائمة التحقق

- [ ] Every number or external fact is added to `SOURCES.md` with a link and a date
- [ ] No API keys, personal data or confidential business information
- [ ] Regulatory wording is educational, not legal advice
- [ ] Learner-facing content is in Arabic (with English where possible)
- [ ] Links work and file names follow the convention (lowercase, hyphens)
- [ ] For agents and skills: tested on at least five Arabic cases, results attached
